description.value: The Riverside Inn is a historic boutique hotel, restaurant, and liquor store perched on the Cowichan River in Lake Cowichan, recently under new ownership with extensive renovations blending rustic and modern charm. Guest suites range from standard rooms to a full-kitchen suite, several with private balconies overlooking the river. The on-site River Cafe serves breakfast and lunch, and the property also houses the Best Buy Liquor Store — the largest beer, wine, and spirits selection in town.

address.value: 56 North Shore Road, Lake Cowichan, V0R 2G0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content was successfully fetched and confirms this is a real, operating hotel-restaurant-liquor store complex on the Cowichan River in Lake Cowichan. The hotel subpage confirms free WiFi in all rooms and on-site free parking; the about-us page confirms an on-site bar/restaurant open into the evening ('kids welcome until 9pm'). No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
